limitations: WinHTTP PAC resolution remains synchronous. Its phase timeouts are not a total wall-clock deadline; cancellation is observed after the call returns, not during it.

reviewObjects.name: Media deadline and staged cancellation
reviewObjects.content: Direct CDN preview and original-file save create an absolute deadline before spawn_blocking. Runtime/PAC/worker setup do not reset it. Cancel/deadline guards run before runtime, after runtime and PAC, before spawn and before stdin; polling and post-join checks use the same Instant. Job termination precedes reader joins; error/timeout paths terminate and reap the owned child.
reviewObjects.confirmationAction: Accept the implemented deadline, cancellation and worker cleanup change.

reviewObjects.name: Bounded bundled Node runtime probe
reviewObjects.content: Bundled Node --version uses spawn/try_wait with a two-second deadline and polling capped by the remaining time. Timeout or poll error kills and reaps the owned process. Exact duplicate candidate paths are skipped while preserving search priority.
reviewObjects.confirmationAction: Accept the implemented runtime probe change.
